reasons: ⛔ DEFLATION — PBO over the ELIGIBLE set is 0.671 ≥ 0.2. ⭐ READ IT AS A **TIE**, NOT AS OVERFITTING: the contender spread is 0.114% and the in-sample halves split across arms that are a fraction of a percent apart (L3_direct_to_ref 66% (+0.000%), L1_chain_ols 22% (+0.078%), L2_chain_paweighted 6% (+0.114%)). Which tied arm wins is noise — which is exactly what a trustworthy learner-null looks like (E2.1-r). The honest record is 'no ladder formulation robustly beats the shipped configuration', so the shipped configuration is now PROVEN rather than assumed. Either way it does not ship.
